extraction.notes: Not seen by registered PrimaCare GP; not an emergency

coverage_decision.rationale: Seeing a non-registered GP without meeting a listed exception is a compliance matter, but per Art.7 a single instance only triggers a reminder; it does not reduce reimbursement for this specific claim (exclusion from the model only follows two reminders). The claim should be processed at the standard compulsory-insurance rate. Note the applicable edition is RFBA02-E5 (effective 2025-04-01), not the older RFGM02-E3 (effective 2024-01-01), since the treatment date (2025-05-15) postdates the newer edition.
